title: Sage: A Scalable Framework for Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Without Human Effort
authors_zh: Yuanning Feng，Sinan Wang，Zhengxiang Cheng，Yao Wan，Dongping Chen。
paper_type_zh: 无人工标注的 LLM-as-a-Judge 一致性评测框架
best_for_zh: 需大规模审计自动 judge、但缺少人工金标的团队。
one_line: Introduces consistency-based judge evaluation without human labels; status is explicitly recorded as submission.
用局部偏好稳定性和全局传递性，无需人工标注地审计 LLM judge 的一致性。
why: It adds a paper-backed reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: evaluator/reward/verifier reliability, attack, uncertainty, or reward-hacking research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Judge benchmarks normally require human ground truth, which is costly, limited in scale and can itself encode human bias. This leaves deployed-judge evaluation dependent on labels that may be unavailable.

Sage evaluates judges without human labels using rational-choice consistency: local stability of pairwise preferences and global transitivity across a preference set.

judge 基准通常依赖人工金标，成本高、规模受限，还可能编码人类偏差；这使已部署 judge 的评估依赖于不可得或不稳定的标签。

Sage 不用人工标签，而以理性选择一致性评估 judge：局部是成对偏好的稳定性，全局是完整偏好集合中的传递性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Sage is a label-free judge-evaluation suite. It constructs 650 questions from structured benchmarks and real user queries, probes local pairwise stability and global transitivity, and validates its metrics by correlation with LLMBar and RewardBench2. It identifies situational preference: a judge can change its preference across answer pairs unless a rubric anchors the criterion. The paper’s public page does not confirm a standalone downloadable dataset.
Sage 是无标签 judge 评测套件：它结合结构化基准和真实用户查询构造 650 个问题，探测局部成对稳定性、全局传递性，再以同 LLMBar、RewardBench2 的相关性验证指标。它指出“情境偏好”：缺少 rubric 锚定时，judge 会随答案对改变偏好。公开页面未确认独立可下载数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build 650 questions from structured benchmarks and real-world queries.
  2. Obtain a judge’s pairwise preferences under controlled answer sets.
  3. Measure local stability and global transitivity; low values flag a judge.
  4. Compare label-free scores to LLMBar/RewardBench2. Exact prompts, pair construction and artifact availability must be checked from submission materials.

1. 从结构化基准和真实查询构建 650 个问题。
  2. 在受控答案集合上获得 judge 的成对偏好。
  3. 测局部稳定性、全局传递性；低分即标记 judge 风险。
  4. 将无标签分数与 LLMBar、RewardBench2 比较。提示、配对构造和 artifact 可得性须再核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Sage evaluates 650 questions without human labels and reports that its local/global scores correlate highly with supervised LLMBar and RewardBench2. Its stress test finds Gemini-2.5-Pro and GPT-5 fail to preserve consistent preferences in nearly one quarter of difficult cases. The evidence validates consistency as a scalable proxy in the reported suite; it does not establish that consistency equals human correctness.
Sage 在 650 个问题上不使用人工标签，报告局部/全局分数与有监督的 LLMBar、RewardBench2 高相关。其压力测试显示 Gemini-2.5-Pro、GPT-5 在困难案例中近四分之一无法保持一致偏好。证据支持一致性在该套件中可扩展地代理评估，却不能证明一致性等于人工正确性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Human-labeled judge benchmarks measure agreement. Sage changes the target to rational-choice consistency without labels, using agreement benchmarks only for external validation. Its novelty is the label-free local/global contract, not transitivity itself.
人工金标 judge 基准测的是与人一致。Sage 把目标改为无需标签的理性选择一致性，只用已有基准作外部验证。新意是无标签的局部/全局契约，而不是传递性概念本身。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Consistency cannot establish semantic or human correctness: a stable judge can be stably wrong.
  2. The public page identifies a submission; a stable code/data release and institutional affiliations were not confirmed.
  3. The 650-question suite may not cover deployment-specific shifts. Use human audits for high-stakes decisions.

1. 一致性不能证明语义或人工正确性：稳定 judge 也可能稳定地错。
  2. 公开页标明 submission，未确认稳定代码/数据发布或作者机构。
  3. 650 题套件未必覆盖部署特定漂移；高风险决策仍需人工审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Sage when answer sets are available but human labels are scarce: obtain pairwise verdicts, calculate stability and transitivity, then investigate low-consistency judges or add rubrics. The result is a label-free reliability report. Do not use it alone to certify safety, factuality or human preference.
若已有候选答案但缺人工标签，可用 Sage 获取成对 verdict，计算稳定性和传递性，再调查低一致 judge 或加入 rubric，输出无标签可靠性报告。它不能单独认证安全、事实性或人类偏好。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Sage audits consistency without human labels.
  2. Local stability plus global transitivity are decisive checks.
  3. The suite has 650 questions; no standalone dataset release confirmed.
  4. Top judges fail near one quarter of difficult cases.
  5. Use it to triage judges, then human-audit correctness.

1. 定位：Sage 不用人工标签审计一致性。
  2. 抓手：局部稳定性加全局传递性。
  3. Artifact：套件有 650 题；未确认独立数据集发布。
  4. 证据：顶级 judge 在困难案例近四分之一失稳。
  5. 决定：先筛查 judge，再人工核验正确性。
